messages.subject: Product question
messages.text:
Hi. I just discovered your company and would like to support by ordering something. Is it possible to still get blankets?
 The website says to pre-order by last November. Will they be available again?
 

 Thank you
 Lois

 Yahoo Mail: Search, Organize, Conquer (https://mail.onelink.me/107872968?pid=nativeplacement&c=US_Acquisition_YMktg_315_SearchOrgConquer_EmailSignature&af_sub1=Acquisition&af_sub2=US_YMktg&af_sub3=&af_sub4=100002039&af_sub5=C01_Email_Static_&af_ios_store_cpp=0c38e4b0-a27e-40f9-a211-f4e2de32ab91&af_android_url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yahoo.mobile.client.android.mail&listing=search_organize_conquer)

messages.subject: Re: Product question
messages.text:
Hi Lois,
 

 Thank you so much for your interest in supporting our company — we truly appreciate it 😊
 

 Yes, it is still possible to purchase our blankets. The note about pre-ordering last November was a translation error on the website. Thank you for bringing it to our attention — it should now be corrected.
 

 The blankets are currently available.
 

 Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you have any other questions.
 

 Have a great day!
 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay
